summary: Adapter enforces gated TDD slice lifecycle; Skill input receipt and current contract/validator hashes required; backend hidden state and shell execution forbidden; declared slice and write sets mandatory; RED requires prepared state, failing exit, expected failure ID, tests/docs-only changes; GREEN requires observed RED, passing exit, production-only changes; REFACTOR requires GREEN, passing exit, declared production/tests/docs set; lifecycle finalization yields non-authoritative implementation candidate; stale identities or failed/stale/superseded runs require successor; stage bindings validate unique context/attempt, matching plan/slice/run IDs, attempt IDs, capsule/context hashes, empty authorization; protocol bundle schema and artifact store validated; artifacts must remain inside run, avoid reparse points, preserve append-only observations, reject undeclared/conflicting files, write evidence immutably; execute rejects existing run, persists recovery state, does not authorize acceptance/handoff/release
